name: What causes shower drains to clog?

mainEntity.name: What causes shower drains to clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shower drains commonly clog due to a buildup of hair, soap scum, and mineral deposits. Over time, these materials combine to form a blockage that restricts water flow. Regularly using a drain screen can significantly reduce the amount of hair and debris entering the drain, helping to prevent future clogs. If you notice slow draining, addressing it early can prevent a more severe blockage from forming.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hair, soap scum, and mineral deposits are the primary causes of shower drain clogs, restricting water flow.
